The '''Planetary Fire Suppression Office''' was an agency operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. It ensured that buildings in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] were built with the proper specifications to prevent fires. Fire fighting services were provided by the Alliance's [[Coruscant Fire and Rescue]] organization.
